verdict.rationale: Fireflies generates action items after every meeting. It also documents a GraphQL API to fetch transcripts, webhooks that fire when transcription completes, and a Zapier connection for automating workflows. An agent could use these to pick up each meeting's output and push it onward, but no native Linear/Jira/Asana integration is evidenced and the filing step must be built externally. Missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integration, documented action-items field in the API schema, an end-to-end tracker-filing example, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows
Connect Fireflies webhooks to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.
The transcript query is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript ID.
